title: WiFi & Network Security
subtitle: Inspect your wireless connection security, nearby networks, VPN status, and active network interfaces.
emptyDesc: Run a scan to inspect your WiFi security posture and network interfaces.
noWifi: No active WiFi connection. Connect to a wireless network to view connection security.
redactedSsidHint: Your WiFi network name is hidden. Grant Location access for Clarity to reveal it.
locationBannerBody: macOS hides WiFi network names and details from apps that don't have Location Services access. Grant access to reveal them.
locationOpenSettingsHint: Location access denied. Opening System Settings — enable Location Services for Clarity, then rescan.
locationOpenSettings: If nothing changes, enable Location Services for Clarity in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services.
nearbyEmpty: No nearby networks detected. WiFi scanning may require permissions.
